evidence_boundaries: The Discover Physics paper is a formally published Perspective built on projected EuPRAXIA@SPARC_LAB source parameters and prior conventional-FEL demonstrations; it reports no completed PWFA-FEL user experiment.

The Luoma paper contributes an analytic ESH model and author SMILEI simulations, while its experimental support is a re-analysis of previously published data; the 37 percent value is an idealized total-ion upper limit, not a new measured proton efficiency.

The Weber paper anchors to NIF experimental ignition but all 10 MJ yields, robustness scans, LPI calculations, and plant power figures are author simulations or conditional systems scenarios, not an operating fusion power plant.
No FEL, SMILEI, HYDRA, LASNEX, pF3D, ghost-spectroscopy inversion, or raw experimental analysis was rerun locally.
